title: Support for: Service teams lack an adequate way to collect client sign-off or retain attributable approval history.
snippet: of Truth Approvals scattered across email, Slack, text, and Zoom recordings are an operational liability. When a dispute arises, 'did they approve this?' becomes a 30-minute archaeology project. Single source of truth means: every approval request and every approval response lives in one place, with a clear record of who approved what and when. Options: Client portal : Most agencies' best option. Approvals are timestamped, attached to deliverables, and visible to the whole team and client. Project management tool: Acceptable if it has a structured approval feature. Asana and ClickUp do not really; AgencyPro does. Shared spreadsheet: Better than nothing for very small agencies; falls apart above 10 active engagements. Email-only: Workable but
